vision.problem: A solo developer using AI coding agents loses track of what to build next, why, and where work stopped, because agents forget between sessions and act on every idea at once.
vision.customer: A solo developer, or a very small team, who builds with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Copilot, or Codex, and installs skills into their repositories.

outcomes.text: `npx skills add https://github.com/purview-dev/pm-skills -y` followed by `pm-setup` leaves a repository with the rules merged, and every pm-* skill and every workflow skill reported installed.
After compaction or a new session, `pm-resume` names the active item, its stage, and the next action from `planning/` alone.

During an active workflow, only the Non-interruption rules' exceptions run (capture, `pm-checkpoint` stage, done, push and pop, `pm-pause`, `pm-revise`, and the read-only views and checks); every other PM skill waits, and a capture replies in one line while the step in progress resumes.
`pm-export` writes a schema-valid `planning.json`, and `pm-docs-site` builds a site from it whose `just docs-check` passes.

outOfScope: Teams and shared boards: multi-user assignment, permissions, or a shared hosted board. PM state is files in one repository.
Non-Bun tooling: npm- or pnpm-only toolchains for validation and the docs site.

constraints.stack: Markdown skills, Bun scripts, just, markdownlint-cli2, GitHub Actions

focus.whyNow: every item in Next serves it, and the brief `planning/briefs/2026-11-17-docs-site-package.md` records copied templates, unpinned packages, and rules bumps for template changes as current costs.

bets.signal: two builds from the same `planning.json` and lockfile give byte-identical HTML, and a package upgrade changes only `package.json` and `bun.lock`.

reviews.summary: Inbox 19 to 3. Added R-022, R-023, R-024, R-025, R-026; 9 files merged, 1 dropped, 2 to shape; R-019 promoted to Next for re-slicing; Next reordered.

inbox.title: Package tests slow the pre-push hook
inbox.idea: R-008 added `package-test` to `just lint-check`, which the lefthook pre-push hook runs. It adds two Astro builds, a pack, and a networked `bun install` to every push: about 40 to 60 seconds, and a push fails offline. Keep it, move it to CI only, or run only the fast unit tests on pre-push?

inbox.title: Brief still says docs-site views are static first
inbox.idea: In R-010 design (2026-11-18) the user chose rich interactive components for every docs-site view, with React islands (React over Preact, so R-011 and R-012 can use React-first libraries such as React Flow). The brief's Performance ramification still says "Render static HTML first and enhance with small islands", and its Ramifications do not mention the React runtime dependency every consumer now gets. Update the brief (pm-shape) so R-011 and R-012 design from the new direction.

inbox.title: R-010 deferred board polish
inbox.idea:
Minor findings from R-010's task and final reviews, triaged "can wait":

- The 3s reveal of a pending board also fires on a slow but successful hydration (brief unfiltered view, then the filtered one); say so in `components.css` and the `useBoardUrlState.ts` header, or tune it.
- The pending mark is also set on `/plan/roadmap/?owner=...` (inert today); scope it to the Board page when R-011 adds Roadmap filters.
- `useBoardUrlState` `replaceState` drops non-board query parameters and `history.state`.
- The lane header is a plain `div`; an `h3` or `role="heading"` would make lanes navigable.
- Before hydration, `aria-expanded` is `true` on columns the pre-paint script already collapsed.
- The card list is serialised into the island's `props` beside the rendered HTML, roughly doubling the Board page; watch it for R-011 and R-012.
- A collapsed column's vertical title stretches the shared header row.
- `kanban.css` duplicates the Astro cards' scoped styles and keeps dead `.k-item:focus-visible` and `cursor: grab` (suggests drag and drop); its header comment lists only some changes.
- `board.ts`: repeated `(X as string[]).includes` casts; `lanes()` branches repeat their tail; `lanes(..., 'none')` returns the input array.
- `board-data.ts` casts loose owner strings to `Owner | null`; no fixture Done entry with a null `id` (key fallback, `href: null`, and the Done-tag rule untested); `tagHref` never asserted.
- `integration.test.ts` asserts the integration names two ways.
- `install.test.ts` uses a 60s `afterAll` timeout for slow Windows `rmSync`.
- The `dev` Playwright project adds about 25s per browser run and leaves one temp folder per machine; the optimizeDeps guard is untested under Yarn PnP.

inbox.title: Timeline island lacks its import-rule note
inbox.idea: Deferred minor from the R-022 final review: `Graph.tsx:5-7` states in the island itself that it may import only types from `lib/graph`, but `Timeline.tsx` has no matching note that it may import only types from `lib/timeline` (values come from `lib/timeline-state.ts`). Add a one-line header note so the next edit keeps the rule. The reviewer also suggested a `bun test` guard that walks `src/components/**` and fails on a value import of `lib/planning`, `lib/timeline`, `lib/graph`, or `lib/graph-layout` (option 2 in the R-022 design, not chosen then).

inbox.title: R-023 deferred browser test review minors
inbox.idea: Four minor findings from the R-023 final review, deferred: (1) `sampleFrames` counts observer records toward the 5-frame post-hydration tail (`stopAtFrame = frames.length + 5`), so as few as 3 real animation frames are sampled after hydration; count rAF samples separately. (2) `record(true)` on a pending-mark removal reads `visible` and `layout` after the removal, recording an impossible `pending: true, visible: true` frame; push `visible: false` or comment it as a marker. (3) `arrowheadFill` reports `marker-end is not url(#id) (marker-end: null)` when the edge path itself is missing; add a `no edge path` reason. (4) `playwright.config.ts` could say `--project=dev` now runs only through `bun run test:browser:dev`.

inbox.title: R-020 deferred demo check review minors
inbox.idea: Four minor findings from the R-020 final review, deferred: (1) `scripts/check-demo.ts` scans only `plan/` pages, so the home page's empty states ("Nothing in Next can be started.", "No open risk is red.") are not checked; include `index.html`. (2) The `Nothing links here yet.` allowlist entry is unused in today's demo build; drop it until a feature page needs it. (3) The demo export records this repository's branch and head (`feat/r-020-docs-site-demo-fixture`, `c2220cd`) as its source, now frozen by `export.ts write --frozen`; pin a neutral source. (4) The opening-tag regex in `emptyStates` also matches `data-class=`, and an unclosed `plan-empty` element swallows the rest of the page (loud false positives only).

inbox.title: Docs-site build warns docs 404 entry missing
inbox.idea: Every pm-docs-site build, with or without the `docs` option, logs `[WARN] [content] Entry docs → 404 was not found.` while rendering /404.html: Starlight's 404 route calls `getEntry('docs', '404')` and falls back to its built-in page when the entry is missing. R-019 removed the missing-folder and empty-collection warnings but not this one. A `404` entry in the docs collection, or Starlight's `disable404Route` with the package's own 404 page, would remove it; check that a `404` entry is not also routed as /404/.

inbox.title: R-019 deferred reference review minors
inbox.idea: Two minor findings from the R-019 final review, deferred: (1) the shared reference boundary `(?<![\w/-])` in `src/lib/ref-boundary.ts` means an ID after `/` is never linked, so the second ID in `M1/M2` or `R-011/R-012`, and a brief path written `./planning/briefs/x.md`, stay plain text; the link test shares the boundary, so it cannot flag it. Either give IDs a boundary that allows a leading `/` outside a path, or pin `M1/M2` as intended in `test/references.test.ts`. (2) `src/pages/plan/log.astro:41` prints `<id> <title>` as plain text when the entry's ID has no target, so known IDs inside that title are not linked; render `{entry.id} <LinkedText text={entry.title} />` in that case.

inbox.title: Dev browser test webserver start timed out
inbox.idea: `just lint-check` (via `package-test`) failed once on R-019's branch: `test:browser:dev` timed out after 300000ms waiting for `config.webServer`. The dev server logged `transport was disconnected, cannot call "fetchModule"`, `Listen method has been called more than once without closing`, and `transport invoke timed out after 60000ms`. An immediate re-run of `bun run test:browser:dev` passed 3/3, and R-019 changed nothing on the dev path.

inbox.title: R-027 deferred review minors
inbox.idea: Minors from the R-027 Docs-site package: build hardening final review, deferred: (1) `test/build.test.ts` probe test can leave `lib/__probe__` behind if the run is killed, and `prepack` would then ship `dist/__probe__/`; the restoring rebuild in `finally` ignores its exit code (gitignore `lib/__probe__/` or assert the exit code). (2) `test/install.test.ts` `relativeImports` skips side-effect imports (`import '../styles/x.css'`, `import '../scripts/plan.ts'`). (3) The install test counts a bare directory as a resolved import (the `''` suffix); use `statSync(...).isFile()`. (4) "non-JavaScript" wording remains in `.github/workflows/publish-pm-docs-site.yml:151`, `docs/wiki/contributing/Repository-Layout.md:57`, and `packages/pm-docs-site/README.md:219`; `check-exports` now reports "the wrong kind of file". (5) `docs/wiki/contributing/Development.md:71` uses `0.1.0-pre.1` as a format example; mark it "for example" so it is not read as the current release.

inbox.title: R-026 deferred review minors
inbox.idea: Minors from the R-026 pm-checkpoint keeps every item field final review, deferred: (1) `skills/pm-lint/scripts/structure.ts` comment on `NOW_NOTE` says "rules 22"; the change shipped on rules 21 (21.0.0-pre.2). (2) The R-026 spec (design item 6) and plan (Task 3) still describe `just bump major` to rules 22; add a superseded line. (3) The `now/fields` rule text in `rules.md`, `rules.ts`, and the `checkNow` message says "and then an optional Note", readable as after `Started`; say "an optional Note after Revisits".
